### 🔵 Needs a closer look Missing baseline collection tasks leave default Secrets Manager and RDS Data telemetry documented only under experimental profiles. **No open issues** 🎉
1 previously missed issue In code that hasn't changed since last review
Register baseline Secrets Manager and RDS Data test tasks `.github/​scripts/​instrumentations.sh:64` [Testing] Collect the baseline `aws-sdk:aws-sdk-1.11:library:testSecretsManager` and `aws-sdk:aws-sdk-2.2:library:testRdsData` tasks alongside their experimental variants. Secrets Manager emits `aws.secretsmanager.secret.arn` by default, and RDS Data emits SQL attributes such as `db.query.text` and `db.query.summary` by default. No registered baseline task exercises these suites, so the new collection records those attributes only under the experimental builder label. Register both baseline tasks with `metadataConfig` unset, following `instrumentation-docs/readme.md:13-14,61-67`.
3 resolved since last review - [Include default-propagator SQS error test in AWS 2.2 profile](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/pull/20649#discussion_r4300806045) - [Exclude SqsProcessMetricsIsolationTest from collection variant](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/pull/20649#discussion_r4300806028) - [Include SQS error test in AWS 1.11 collection profile](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/pull/20649#discussion_r4300806011)
Review effort: Balanced

Collect exception-log metadata for AWS SDK 1.11, AWS SDK 2.2, and OkHttp 3.0.

Organize AWS library tests into default and named opt-in profiles corresponding to the javaagent variants. Test selection stays fixed when metadata collection is enabled.

Label programmatically configured library profiles with builder calls, not agent properties that do not configure the library. Keep genuine shared properties such as `otel.semconv.exception.signal.preview=logs` as property conditions, and document this distinction in collection and agent guidance.

For OkHttp, register the baseline exception-log task without adding equivalent library-version variants or `logs/dup` collection.
metadata.title: Collect exception-log metadata for AWS SDK and OkHttp
